phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.8×42mm DBP10 primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 315 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 315 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 463 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Short-Stroke Pulse & Operating Impulse

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 30-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the QBZ-95-1 staged for its 650 RPM cyclic · thumb-accessible selector cadence.

zh.headline: 中国 95-1 式 5.8mm 无托自动步枪：1995 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 由朵英贤院士团队主持研制的 95 式枪族及其深度改进型 95-1 式采用独具特色的 5.8×42mm 小口径高存能弹药与轻量化无托聚合物壳体结构，在 763 mm 总长内容纳 463 mm 全长枪管，并新增拇指快慢机、空仓挂机与前斜向抛壳优化。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：QBZ-95-1 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1995 年问世的 中国 95-1 式 5.8mm 无托自动步枪 由中国中国兵器工业集团 208 研究所（Norinco）主导研制，定位为经典的无托式突击步枪。QBZ-95 枪族于 1997 年香港回归驻港部队首次公开亮相，此后衍生出短步枪、班用机枪与 95-1 改进全系列，构成中国步兵二十余年数字化转型的主力基石。
由朵英贤院士团队主持研制的 95 式枪族及其深度改进型 95-1 式采用独具特色的 5.8×42mm 小口径高存能弹药与轻量化无托聚合物壳体结构，在 763 mm 总长内容纳 463 mm 全长枪管，并新增拇指快慢机、空仓挂机与前斜向抛壳优化。 整件装备总长 763 mm（全长紧凑 · 463 mm 长枪管）、空重 3.25 kg，成为同期无托式步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1995 年，中国中国兵器工业集团 208 研究所（Norinco）推出了划时代的中国 95-1 式 5.8mm 无托自动步枪。QBZ-95 枪族于 1997 年香港回归驻港部队首次公开亮相，此后衍生出短步枪、班用机枪与 95-1 改进全系列，构成中国步兵二十余年数字化转型的主力基石。 它的核心设计聚焦于独创 5.8×42mm DBP10 通用小口径弹，在 5.56mm 与 7.62mm 之间取得卓越侵彻与存能平衡，奠定了其在无托式步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 中国 95-1 式 5.8mm 无托自动步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「短行程导气活塞（3 档调气）· 3 闭锁突笋回转枪机与工程塑料机匣壳体」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。95-1 型将快慢机前移至小握把虎口上方，并新增空仓挂机与 45° 前斜抛壳导向，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。中国 95-1 式 5.8mm 无托自动步枪 采用短行程导气活塞（3 档调气）· 3 闭锁突笋回转枪机与工程塑料机匣壳体。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了95-1 型将快慢机前移至小握把虎口上方，并新增空仓挂机与 45° 前斜抛壳导向。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.8×42mm DBP10 弹药规格与 463 mm 镀铬精锻重枪管（4 条右旋渐速膛线 · 240 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 315 MPa，可赋予弹头 930 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,990 J 动能，有效作用距离达 400 米。
内膛技术特点方面，5.8×42mm DBP10 通用弹兼具高截面密度与远距存能优势，95-1 加重枪管提升连发精度。同时，3 档可调短行程活塞配合三闭锁突笋枪机，重心精准落在握把正上方，令其在 650 发/分（全自动）· 拇指快慢机优化 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 463 毫米身管与 5.8×42mm DBP10 口径，中国 95-1 式 5.8mm 无托自动步枪 实现了每秒 930 米的初速与 400 米有效射程。5.8×42mm DBP10 通用弹兼具高截面密度与远距存能优势，95-1 加重枪管提升连发精度，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 48 mm 膛轴设计，中国 95-1 式 5.8mm 无托自动步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.9 N·s 水平。低矮一体化燕尾提把兼容白光/微光瞄具，全枪仅 3.25 kg 且拆装高度模块化。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-45）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，低矮一体化燕尾提把兼容白光/微光瞄具，全枪仅 3.25 kg 且拆装高度模块化。欢迎在 BAY-45 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 中国 95-1 式 5.8mm 无托自动步枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the QBZ-95-1
paragraphs: Introduced in 1995 by Norinco / 208 Research Institute in China, the Norinco QBZ-95-1 emerged as a defining Bullpup Assault Rifle. Publicly unveiled during the 1997 Hong Kong garrison handover, the QBZ-95 family expanded into carbine, LSW, and modernized QBZ-95-1 variants serving as the backbone of PLA infantry modernization.

Engineered around China’s proprietary 5.8×42mm DBP10 high-ballistic-coefficient cartridge, the QBZ-95-1 packs a full 463 mm chrome-lined barrel into a 763 mm polymer bullpup shell with thumb-reachable controls and last-round hold-open. Measuring 763 mm (Compact Bullpup · 463 mm Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 3.25 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1995, Norinco / 208 Research Institute of China introduced the Norinco QBZ-95-1. Publicly unveiled during the 1997 Hong Kong garrison handover, the QBZ-95 family expanded into carbine, LSW, and modernized QBZ-95-1 variants serving as the backbone of PLA infantry modernization. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Proprietary 5.8×42mm DBP10 round balances flat trajectory with high downrange energy retention — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Norinco QBZ-95-1 sits its Short-Stroke Gas Piston (3-Pos Regulator) · 3-Lug Rotating Bolt in Polymer Bullpup Shell. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 315 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, QBZ-95-1 relocates the selector above the pistol grip and adds last-round bolt hold-open, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Norinco QBZ-95-1 relies on Short-Stroke Gas Piston (3-Pos Regulator) · 3-Lug Rotating Bolt in Polymer Bullpup Shell. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: QBZ-95-1 relocates the selector above the pistol grip and adds last-round bolt hold-open.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.8×42mm DBP10 with 463 mm Chrome-Lined Heavy Barrel (4-Groove RH · 240 mm Twist), the Norinco QBZ-95-1 develops 930 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,990 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 400 meters.

Internally, 5.8×42mm DBP10 combines high sectional density with flat trajectories through the reinforced 463 mm barrel. Combined with its 650 RPM cyclic · thumb-accessible selector tempo, 3-position short-stroke piston and 3-lug rotating bolt center mass directly over the firing hand, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.8×42mm DBP10 through its 463 millimeter bore, the Norinco QBZ-95-1 achieves 930 meters per second and 400 meters of effective reach. 5.8×42mm DBP10 combines high sectional density with flat trajectories through the reinforced 463 mm barrel.
